shorts.title: Polar Bears Almost Vanish on a Thermal Camera
shorts.hook: Point a thermal camera at a polar bear and it almost disappears.
shorts.outro: Doug's camera worked perfectly. What was still glowing on that screen a second later is in the full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT WAS LEFT GLOWING ON THE SCREEN?
shorts.description: A polar bear's coat is nearly as cold as the snow, so infrared sees little more than its face; find out what was still glowing on Doug's screen in the full episode.

shorts.title: This Polar Bear Held Its Breath 3 Minutes and Still Missed
shorts.outro: So Doug dressed as a seal and lay on a floe edge, right where the bear comes up. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: DID THE BEAR MISS DOUG TOO?
shorts.description: A Svalbard polar bear swam an Olympic pool's length underwater to stalk three seals and missed them all; see whether Doug, dressed as a seal, gets that lucky in the full episode.

shorts.title: Canada Has a Polar Bear Jail, and It Serves No Food
shorts.hook: Canada has a jail for polar bears. Nobody feeds the prisoners.
shorts.outro: Doug took the rubbish out in that same town. There was a bear in the stairwell. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHO WAS WAITING IN THE STAIRWELL?
shorts.description: Churchill, Canada locks problem polar bears in a holding facility with air-conditioned cells and no food; find out who was waiting for Doug in the stairwell in the full episode.
